class.name: ResonanceAudioRoom
class.brief_description: Room volume that applies reflections and reverb to spatial-audio sources inside it.
class.description: Defines a room bounding volume for the [ResonanceAudioServer]. Sources inside the room are processed with early reflections and late reverb derived from the room's wall material and reverb parameters.

method.name: update_room_from_colliders
method.description: Rebuilds the room bounds from the [CollisionShape3D] children of this node.

members.member: Linear gain applied to the early reflections leaving the room.
Spectral tilt of the late reverb. Positive values brighten it, negative values darken it.
Linear gain applied to the late reverb tail.
Multiplier on the reverb decay time predicted from the room geometry and wall material.
If [code]false[/code], the room is registered but contributes no reflections or reverb.
Acoustic material used for every wall of the room. See [enum ReverbProbeGI.WallMaterial].
